mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_name, p.permission_type, p.perms, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.order_num, p.visible, p.status, p.del_flag, p.api_method, p.api_path, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.order_num

SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_name, p.permission_type, p.perms, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.order_num, p.visible, p.status, p.del_flag, p.api_method, p.api_path, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY p.order_num

SELECT id, parent_id, permission_name, permission_type, perms, path, component, icon, order_num, visible, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 AND permission_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY order_num

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.permission_name, p.permission_type, p.perms, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.order_num, p.visible, p.status, p.del_flag, p.api_method, p.api_path, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.del_flag = 0
AND p.permission_type IN
#{type}
ORDER BY p.order_num ASC, p.create_time ASC
